idea-plugin.name: Wurbelizer
idea-plugin.description:
Editor support for Wurbelizer wurblet sources (*.wrbl).

A wurblet mixes two code levels in one file: the wurblet level (@[ ... ]@, the generator's own Java) and the output level (everything else, the code being generated), with @( expr )@ splicing a wurblet level value into the output and @{ ... }@ carrying wurbiler directives.

The plugin reconstructs both levels as Java and injects them, so code completion, resolution, parameter info and navigation work on the generator code and on the code being generated.

  • Syntax highlighting and brace matching for the level markers, directives and escapes
  • Code completion on both code levels
  • Completion and validation of the wurbiler directives
  • Navigation to @{include}@ files, the @{extends}@ parent class and @{import}@ targets
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.1

  • A backslash followed by a blank (\ ) now stands for the blank alone, matching the fixed wurbiler. It used to be dropped entirely, which could glue two tokens of the injected Java together.

1.0.0

First public release.

  • Syntax highlighting, per-level background tint and brace matching for @[ ]@, @( )@ and @{ }@
  • Java code insight on both the wurblet level and the output level, via language injection
  • Completion and validation of the wurbiler directives
  • Navigation to @{include}@ files, the @{extends}@ parent class and @{import}@ targets
  • Quick fix for unescaped @ sequences
  • Per-project settings under Settings | Languages & Frameworks | Wurblet
